resolution:

2. Navigate to certificate management
3. Import new certificate from IT portal
4. Restart VPN service
5. Test connection

issue: Printer not responding to print jobs
resolution:
1. Open Services (services.msc)
2. Restart Print Spooler service
3. Clear print queue in Control Panel > Devices
4. Remove and re-add printer
5. Update printer driver from manufacturer website

issue: Unable to access shared network drive
resolution:
1. Verify network cable connection or WiFi
2. Try accessing via \server-name\share-name
3. Run 'net use' in cmd to check mapped drives
4. Disconnect and reconnect mapped drive
5. Check Active Directory permissions with IT
